mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.orderId, r.userId, r.dishId, r.rating, r.content, r.replyContent, r.reviewStatus, r.createdAt, u.nickname, CASE WHEN r.dishId IS NULL THEN '本次用餐' ELSE d.dishName END AS reviewTarget FROM dishReview r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.userId LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.id = r.dishId ORDER BY r.createdAt DESC
SELECT r.*, CASE WHEN r.dishId IS NULL THEN '本次用餐' ELSE d.dishName END AS reviewTarget FROM dishReview r LEFT JOIN dish d ON d.id = r.dishId WHERE r.userId = #{userId} ORDER BY r.createdAt DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dishReview (orderId, userId, rating, content) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dishReview WHERE id = #{id} AND userId = #{userId}
